title: RFI - Security Identification Gear
agency_path: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF.FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION.FBI-JEH
detail_text: Response to this Request for Information (RFI) may be used to formulate final requirements and/or to identify qualified vendors capable of meeting those requirements. The description below outlines preliminary requirements envisioned for Security Identification Gear. The preliminary requirement includes apparel, creating a website, and garment customizations (embroidery, Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) logo, silk screening, heat transferred reflective material, and Direct to Film (DTF), and general alterations). The information gathered from responses may be used to formulate acquisition strategies for competitive solicitations. > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > > Please send all responses and questions to Contracting Officer, Kayla Haley at Knhaley@fbi.gov
